program: Wingless fixed-capacity probability-margin source calibration attribution
question: Is the global training-median margin gate failing because margin scale and low-margin exact precision differ materially between source domains?
hypothesis: Replay the exact mixed R2 representation, repaired relation, eight fixed classes, pooled training-median threshold, and heldout population without changing any gate or capacity. Compute source-specific training margin medians for attribution only, plus source-specific repaired exact precision below the unchanged global threshold. The absolute code-versus-structured training-median margin gap will be at least 0.05 and the absolute code-versus-structured below-threshold exact-precision gap will be at least 0.10. All 17 code and 2 structured same-class hidden gains will reproduce below the unchanged global threshold. This would support source calibration as a bounded next readout factor without changing relation or class capacity.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: The global threshold excludes every same-class hidden gain, but low-margin predictions are not globally more precise. The next bounded question is whether margin calibration differs by source.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

attribution_protocol.source_training_margin_median: median of the same frozen repaired depth-3 margin statistic within each source's training-prefix queries; attribution only, never used to gate heldout rows
attribution_protocol.source_below_threshold_precision: repaired exact precision within each source's heldout rows whose margin is below the unchanged global threshold
attribution_protocol.hidden_population: exact R2 same-class hidden gains: code 17, structured 2, technical-prose 0

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and both preregistered source-calibration gaps pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and exactly one source-calibration gap passes.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither source-calibration gap passes.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, threshold/population reproduction, source accounting, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact qualified mixed R2 parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
Representation, relation, class assignments, margin formula, pooled threshold, runtime cap, and horizons are unchanged.
Per-source training medians are attribution outputs only and never influence heldout gating.
The 3732 heldout rows and 19 same-class hidden gains reproduce exactly, including 17 code and 2 structured rows.
Heldout labels affect attribution only and never threshold selection or behavior.
No new learned state, tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relation, classes, margin formula, global threshold, source definitions, 0.05/0.10 attribution floors, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test source-specific training-only margin thresholds while keeping relation and class capacity unchanged

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute margin failure by fixed reasoning class before changing the gate
